brief: Revise a goal when its original cost or purpose changes.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Update the goal"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Actualiza la meta"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Atualize a meta"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Revise a goal when its original cost or purpose changes.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Goals should change when their purpose or cost changes.
instruction.misconception: Keep funding an obsolete target merely because money has already been set aside.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Repair rises from 80 dollars to 110. Recheck the gap and timing; the old plan may fail.
A higher cost changes the unfunded amount.
The original purpose no longer requires the same reservation.

en-US.line: Goals should change when their purpose or cost changes.

en-US.line: Repair rises from 80 dollars to 110. Recheck the gap and timing; the old plan may fail.

es-MX.line: La reparación era de 80 pesos; la nueva cotización es 110. Actualiza faltante y calendario antes de confiar en el plan anterior.

pt-BR.line: O conserto era de 80 reais; o novo orçamento é 110. Atualize falta e calendário antes de confiar no plano anterior.

options.label: Nothing, the old plan is fixed

help: Keep saved money but update the target.

feedback.met: A higher cost changes the unfunded amount.
feedback.not_yet: Keep saved money but update the target.

feedback.met: Un costo mayor cambia el monto sin financiar.

options.label: O que falta e as contribuições
Nada, o plano anterior é fixo

help: Mantenha a poupança, mas atualize a meta.

feedback.met: Um custo maior muda o valor não financiado.
feedback.not_yet: Mantenha a poupança, mas atualize a meta.

options.label: Reconsider the purpose and reassign deliberately

help: Recheck needs before redirecting the money.

feedback.met: The original purpose no longer requires the same reservation.
feedback.not_yet: Recheck needs before redirecting the money.

feedback.met: O propósito original não exige mais a mesma reserva.
feedback.not_yet: Confira necessidades antes de redirecionar dinheiro.

en-US.prompt: Must the replacement goal continue unchanged?
en-US.scene: A replacement item becomes unnecessary because the old one was repaired safely.
help: A goal serves a purpose, not the reverse.

feedback.met: Changed needs justify reviewing the original goal.
feedback.not_yet: A goal serves a purpose, not the reverse.
